prompt: A workflow triggers fine but the first `run:` step fails immediately with `No such file or directory` when touching repository files. What is the classic cause?
explanation: Jobs start on an empty workspace: until `actions/checkout` copies the repository onto the runner, no project files exist there. A missing checkout is one of the most common first-step failures, and permissions have nothing to do with it.

options.text: The runner is out of disk space
The `actions/checkout` step is missing, so the repository was never copied onto the runner
The workflow YAML is indented incorrectly
